t: This was Maria Grey Training College, which trained teachers from 1878 to 1976. When it opened it was the first teacher training college for women in Great Britain. Maria Georgina Grey founded it, and it carries her name. She was a British educationist and writer who promoted women's education, and she helped found the organisation that became the Girls' Day School Trust. She lived from 1816 to 1906, and the college stands as a record of her work.
